notes.title: Per-save file options. Also, the tire can be an elf.
notes.content:
A couple more updates:
[list]
[*]Disagree with your friend on color choices? Tired of having your two-year-old start out in Tire Physics Mode? Well, no more! Tire Friend's cosmetics (colors and hat) and gameplay options are now set per save file, rather than being global. It makes the save files easier to tell apart, too.
[*]Goofy elf hat for the season. Another second hat because it's funny.
[*]Lighting improvements, level tweaks, and bug fixes.
[/list]

If something broke, please let me know. The tire's in Early Access, after all.

And if you're still looking for a last-minute Christmas gift, Tire Friend's still discounted in the Steam Winter Sale for a bit longer. It's about a dollar for a tire. All of your friends will love it!

And a very merry tiring to you and yours!

notes.title: Under the hood: Optimizations, lighting, models, quality of life, ....
notes.content:
A smorgasbord update.

[list]
[*] Improved lighting all throughout. Everywhere.
[*] Significantly reduced the game's file size, something like 20% in the full version.
[*] Snazzified the courses' Finish Lines.
[*] Reworked a few models, such as the Spike Strips and a couple of the hats.
[*] Reworked parts of Asphalt Hill and Dusty Gears levels.
[*] More stats on the hub and course UIs, especially to do with the challenges (Options > Gameplay > Challenges).
[*] Bug fixes, including to Revving Up and polling for the "safe position" (where your tire returns on dropping into a pit).
[/list]

Please let me know what you think. I'd really like feedback on performance: has it improved? Has it... done the opposite?

And, in any case—as always, happy tiring!

notes.title: So, about those ranks...
notes.content:
A couple notes:
[list]
[*] Ranks are twice as hard to grab now. S rank is 20k points rather than 10k as before. A rank is 10k rather than 5k. And so on and so forth. Please don't hate me!
[*] And even then, S is kids' stuff. There's a cool new ranking above S. All you have to do is clear a stage. With 20k points. After grabbing all of the Golden Hubcaps in the stage in one go. With both Challenges (Options > Gameplay) active. Meaning no powerups, no checkpoints, and a slowly leaking tire that gets harder and harder to control. It's verified possible!
[*] Oh, and rebalancing, level tweaks, and bug fixes.
[/list]

All of the above is in the full and demo versions. Full version havers should get another new level pretty shortly, too.

As always, let me know your thoughts.

Happy tiring!

notes.title: Tweaks to physics, UI, and settings.
notes.content:
Exciting stuff here: some things are very slightly different!

Among other things:
[list]
[*] Screen resolution options are more straightforward. Hopefully, it all still works! (I do need to fix how UI scaling changes with window size and screen resolution, though.)
[*] All of the Options tabs (aside from Data and, of course, Steam Feedback) have a button to restore defaults.
[*] There should be a lot fewer reading/writing to save/settings files. Which should speed up loading times, especially on lower-end machines.
[*] Tire Friend himself has a couple of visual indicators for some of the difficulty options (Panic/Leak/Challenge Mode, Tire "Physics" Mode, and air leak rate) in the hub world. May need to make these more obvious.
[*] Tire Friend jumps a little bit higher.
[*] Some levels have been tweaked. In one level, I shoehorned in some Ring Lasers because they work better than rotating burners.
[*] Some more level stats are tracked, including whether you've beaten a level in Panic/Leak/Challenge Mode and your largest score multiplier. They're not displayed yet, but they will be.
[*] Pause screen in-level also displays your best time, best score, and your current score multiplier. Pretty sure that's new since last time, anyway.
[*] Some bug fixes.
[/list]

All of these are in the full version and the demo.

Let me know if anything broke. Let me know if you have any suggestions. Let me know if you've tested the game on a widescreen or 4K monitor, because I don't have access to any of that.

Happy tiring!

notes.title: You've got options: Difficulty, graphics, and more!
notes.content:
A couple of things.

The game now has a Difficulty menu, where you can set the game's speed and even enable a couple challenges. Right now, you can only access it between levels (at the hub world or title screen). These affect your score, but nothing else. I'm still working on how all of that behaves, and it's bound to change during Early Access. Let me know if you have suggestions!

If you disable full screen mode, you can (or should be able to?) drag the window to resize. It should snap to one of a couple different aspect ratios. I've opted to [b]not[/b] automatically scale the UI when this happens, but the option is still available. Let me know if you have suggestions!

There are also some other options in the menu, like gamma adjustment (Graphics) and disabling screen shake effects (Camera). Let me know if you have.. et cetera!

Some other items:
[list]
[*] I'm also working on making the very bottom graphics quality run on the lowest of the low-end machines.
[*] If you get defeated five times in a level, an assist item known as the Bubble will spawn.
[*] If you collect a Powerup but don't want it, you can just put it back where it was.
[*] On the Pause screen, there's a POINT OF ADVICE with a hint at the very top of the screen. It's randomly selected, so you can keep pausing and unpausing to see them all. For now. Still working on how this behaves, and I might be able to categorize or contextualize the hints.
[/list]
